nodes.name: Filas de proveedores (reemplazar por lectura de Excel)

parameters.query:
-- Upsert de proveedor en la tabla users (is_sales = FALSE).
-- Se ejecuta una vez por fila (item) que entra desde el Excel.
-- Parámetros:
--   $1 internal_id (ID_PROVEEDOR)      $2 name (NOMBRE_PROVEEDOR)
--   $3 estado texto (ESTADO)           $4 documento (no viene en el Excel)
--   $5 telefono movil (TELEFONO_MOVIL) $6 correo (CORREO_ELECTRONICO)
--   $7 direccion (DIRECCION)           $8 otro telefono (OTRO_TELEFONO)
--   $9 fecha nac. (no viene)           $10 sexo (no viene)
--   $11 otra info (OTRA_INFO)          $12 is_active (boolean, derivado de ESTADO)
INSERT INTO users (
  internal_id, name, is_active, is_sales,
  identity_document, phone_number, email,
  address, alternative_phone, birthday, notes
)
SELECT
  v.internal_id,
  v.name,
  v.is_active,
  FALSE,                       -- is_sales = FALSE  -> proveedor (compras)
  CASE WHEN v.cand_doc IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.identity_document = v.cand_doc)
       THEN v.cand_doc ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN v.cand_phone IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.phone_number = v.cand_phone)
       THEN v.cand_phone ELSE NULL END,
  CASE WHEN v.cand_email IS NOT NULL
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.email = v.cand_email)
       THEN v.cand_email ELSE NULL END,
  v.address,
  v.alternative_phone,
  v.birthday,
  v.notes
FROM (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(TRIM($1::text), '') AS internal_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM($2::text), ''), 'Sin nombre') AS name,
    CASE WHEN (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE($3::text, '1'))) IN ('activo','active','true','','1') OR COALESCE($3,1)=1) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_active,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(COALESCE($4::text,''), '[^0-9A-Za-z]', '', 'g'), '') AS cand_doc,
    CASE
      WHEN length(regexp_replace(COALESCE($5::text,''), '\D', '', 'g')) >= 7
        THEN right(regexp_replace($5::text, '\D', '', 'g'), 9)
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cand_phone,
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE($6::text,''))) ~ '^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
        THEN LOWER(TRIM($6::text))
      ELSE NULL
    END AS cand_email,
    NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE($7::text,'')), '') AS address,
    NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE($8::text,'')), '') AS alternative_phone,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE($9::text,'') ~ '^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{4}$' THEN to_date($9::text, 'MM/DD/YYYY')
      WHEN COALESCE($9::text,'') ~ '^\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}$' THEN to_date($9::text, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
      ELSE NULL
    END AS birthday,
    'Origen: Proveedores'
      || E'\n' || 'Estado origen: ' || COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM($3::text),''), 'desconocido')
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($4::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Documento: ' || TRIM($4::text) ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($5::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Movil: ' || TRIM($5::text) ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($6::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Correo: ' || TRIM($6::text) ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($10::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Sexo: ' || TRIM($10::text) ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($9::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Fecha nacimiento: ' || TRIM($9::text) ELSE '' END
      || CASE WHEN COALESCE(TRIM($11::text),'') <> '' THEN E'\n' || 'Otra info: ' || TRIM($11::text) ELSE '' END
      AS notes
) v
WHERE v.internal_id IS NOT NULL
ON CONFLICT (internal_id) DO UPDATE
    SET internal_id = EXCLUDED.internal_id,
        is_active   = $12
RETURNING id;
